verdict.rationale: Penpot documents and (per runtime probe) actually ships a working self-hosted MCP server that lets any AI agent read/write design files as code, and marketing copy explicitly frames this as 'prompt away' to create designs (penpot-docs-31, penpot-docs-32, penpot-probe-rt-2). However this is an indirect path — the natural-language generation itself happens in a third-party AI agent connected via MCP, not a native in-app prompt-to-mockup feature, and there is no hands-on evidence of actual generated first drafts/mockups or their quality. Missing for 10: first-party in-product prompt-to-design UI, hands-on/independent verification of generated mockup quality, and evidence of full-mockup generation (not just file read/edit access).
